I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

It's the full 1280px screen inside `#component`, in static HTML and CSS with no JavaScript, using the exact copy you gave. I followed `DESIGN.md`, the only design file in the folder (`session.json` is empty and `session.err` holds only a model-name error).

- **Layout:** each section has its heading in the left four columns and a card in the right eight. The grid is 12 columns with 32px gutters and 64px margins.
- **Colors and type:** only the listed palette and sizes. The page title is Unbounded Light 56px in caps, and section titles are Unbounded Medium 28px.
- **Buttons:** "Save Changes" is a primary ink pill. "Delete Workspace" is a quiet pill with an ink outline. The spec has no red, so the Danger zone stands out only by its heading and text.
- **Switches:** the switches are CSS-only checkboxes. "Email me…" and "Weekly summary" start on and "Product updates" starts off, which is my choice since you didn't say.
- **Fonts:** no font files are bundled, per your "no assets" rule. Unbounded and Archivo will only render if they're installed locally. Otherwise it falls back to Helvetica Neue or Arial.
